why: EGM behaviour can change under a passing suite when a dependency moves. These are the revisions every measurement in this repository was taken against. A run record cites them; the runbook checks them before a validation run against a real machine. libsas is re-pinned whenever its version increases.

libsas.measured: Measured on 2026-11-28 against the demo v2.0.4.37 built with QSP v2.3.6.34 and QPM2 v9.0.0.14, on the shared ProgramData memory restored before each run and qpm_storage.bin 6183DE07, on a demo started seconds before each run, with no --egm-exe or --egm-bet-credits so the same cases run as at v5.4.6.16. With the layout-19 golden memory the regression tree gave 19 pass, 17 fail, 14 skip, and with the secure-enhanced memory 12 pass, 21 fail, 17 skip, both the same verdict in every case as v5.4.6.16. The 13 hand pay cases gave 7 pass, 0 fail, 6 skip on both memories, case for case as before. The M7 tree has grown since v5.4.6.16 was measured, and every case it ran then kept its verdict except 10.2.5, which now passes after its order fix. On golden it gave 37 pass, 8 fail, 136 skip: the eight failures are cases that were skipped then, 10.3.11 to 10.3.14 (the printed ticket carries no location or address) and 10.7.10, 10.7.11, 10.7.13 and 10.7.14 (golden memory takes no ticket in). On secure-enhanced the whole tree gave 36 pass, 10 fail, 128 skip, 7 errors, because 10.5.1, also skipped then, clears the validation identifier with $7B, gets no $3F and leaves the machine unable to print or redeem, so the sixteen ticket cases after it fail or error; without 10.5.1 chapter 10 gave 22 pass, 0 fail, 49 skip. None of the libsas changes since v5.4.6.16 touch the long polls these cases use.
libsas.howItIsHeld: QSP v2.3.6.34 declares libsas as FetchContent 'sas' at v5.4.6.16, and that declaration is not ours to edit. The presets SasWorkbenchM0 and SasWorkbenchM0-Scripted in the demo clone at C:/work/QSP_DemoOpenGL-2.0.4.37 override it with FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_SAS, pointing the build at a clone held at this commit, C:/work/libsas-5.4.6.26, because the checkout at C:/Progetti/libsas is moved between branches by other work.

qsp.howItIsHeld: Declared by the demo v2.0.4.37 and fetched as released, so the preset does not override it.

demo.howItIsHeld: A separate clone at C:/work/QSP_DemoOpenGL-2.0.4.37, so the shared checkout at C:/Progetti/QSP_DemoOpenGL is never moved. The gitignored preset SasWorkbenchM0 lives in that clone and builds into bin/SasWorkbenchM0.

qpm2.howItIsHeld: Declared by QSP v2.3.6.34 and fetched as released. Its simulated acceptor reports tickets, so the preset does not override it.

qpmSimulator.howItIsHeld: The version QSP v2.3.6.34 declares. SASWB_QPM_SIMULATOR_ROOT in the M0 preset points at the checkout at C:/Progetti/qpm_simulator, whose ticket encoder and wallet the substituted printer compiles in.

nvramArrangement.note: QSP 2.3.6.34 writes NVRAM layout 19, as QSP 2.3.6.32 (pull request 815) did, and reads the same fixtures. The committed fixtures were configured by hand on 2026-11-05: an attendant NVRAM reset, then maker QX, address 1 on channel 1, asset 1, note acceptor 102, printer 101, standard validation, no ticket-in, and game denominations of 5, 10, 50 and 100 cents. After a reset the demo raises vendor condition 1 (licence key, 'Custom Condition 1') itself, which keeps the bill acceptor off, so it was cleared on the Licence Key audit page before saving. The accounting denomination of five cents was written with 'sasctl nvram denomination 0.05', and the secure-enhanced memory was written from the golden one. The configuration block is still at 0x000A00, and the host-link block moved from 0x00FF1E to 0x00FF22. The machine reported code $02 on long poll 1F. That build gives a newly chosen denomination its own enable record, switched off, so every game was saved disabled; 'sasctl nvram games enable' switched on each denomination the five-cent unit divides, and the memory as saved by hand is kept in fixtures/nvram/arrangement-19-as-saved. The game records sit at 0x01034E, 0x954 apart, measured on the simulator only. The layout-15 fixtures for a QSP v2.3.6.1 demo are kept in fixtures/nvram/arrangement-15, and the arrangement-7 ones in fixtures/nvram/arrangement-7.
